ext.description: IDE agent orchestrator — coordinates agent CLIs (claude, codex, ...) as workers in a gated pipeline
config.defaultRepo: Default repo when the workspace has no .orchestra/ (empty = use the prototype demo-repo)
config.autoApprovePlan: Run Pipeline: auto-approve the plan node without stopping to ask (not recommended for real repos)
config.hooksEnabled: Pre-execution guard hook — blocks git push, network patterns and path escapes BEFORE the command runs
config.templatesDir: Pipeline templates directory (empty = templates bundled with the extension)
config.orchestratorWorker: CLI used as the Orchestrator brain in Chat (runs read-only, resumes the session to remember the conversation)
